decisions.reason: Tighter prose; “went beyond reckless” matches 무모함을 넘어 without extra “looked like.”
“Wasn’t worth dying for” is more natural English for 목숨을 버릴 정도는 아니다.
개죽음 is dying like a dog; BASE adds “stray” and “throwing his life away.”
Both complete the reach; Korean is 뻗으려던 at 그 순간. SOL also drops the moment-cliffhanger and changes 꼬나 쥔 to “leveled.”
decisions.replacement: It was at that very moment, when Im Kkeokjeong was about to reach out toward Jin Taekyung, who had just gripped his spear at the ready.

decisions.reason: Drops the repeated name and renders 바람 소리와 함께 as a rush of wind.
Simple past is tighter and still matches the blink-of-an-eye beat.
Comma versus ellipsis is indistinguishable; Korean punctuates with a comma.
SOL drops 넘는; BASE inserts “monster,” which this line does not say.
decisions.replacement: The Minotaur’s enormous, over-three-meter-tall body tilted to one side.

decisions.reason: “Risen above” is a stronger collocation for the missing neck.
SOL adds “almost” and weakens 착각/그저 into a mere resemblance.
Reduced relative clause is cleaner without changing the action.
왈칵 쏟아졌다 is gushed; “stump” naturalizes 단면 better than “cross-section.”
SOL drops 마음을 대변한다 and turns 목소리 into “exclamation.”
SOL replaces 보이지 않는 충격과 경악 with unsupported “stunned silence.”
특화된 is specialized; “built for” is only a looser synonym.
Uncountable “muscle” is the idiomatic collocation with “packed with.”
One-sentence 말짱 황 punch with “land a hit” is more idiomatic.
애꿎은 is the innocent/unoffending floor, not merely “poor.”
힘 하나는 인정 does not add “impressive.”
More direct clause order, and “drove my spear” fits the thrust better than generic “stabbed.”
푸푹 is a piercing stab sound, not a squish.
SOL hedges “sounded,” adds “dregs,” and turns 조금 전의 그 공격 into “its last attack.”
녀석에게로 marks the target; SOL’s “approached as” can read as mere timing.
“Those” is more immediate in close first-person narration.
숨이 끊겼다 is the death idiom “breathed its last.”
“That made eight” captures the completed tally of 늘어난 순간.
SOL drops the second-clause 이 영화의 callback.
Wide smile and broad smile are indistinguishable for 활짝 웃으며.
Comma-only change is indistinguishable.
SOL drops 유독 and changes 휩싸여 to “frozen.”
얼어붙은 is frozen, not paralyzed; 정산 should stay settlement.
SOL omits 일단 (“to start with”).
Comma before “too” is indistinguishable.
Comma splice into one spoken plea is more natural dialogue.
SOL omits 아까부터 (“for a while / since earlier”).
그렇게 is “that,” not a generic “so.”
Restores the 혓바닥이 반 토막 joke BASE genericizes.
달아올랐다 is flushed, not merely “grew red.”
Imperative-plus-and is more spoken for the threat.
표정 관리 is composing his expression, the face joke at issue.
번갈아 is more naturally “back and forth.”
Drops extra “Just” not needed for 알아서 생각하고.
“Denied it” is tighter than “said it wasn’t.”
발라 버렸 is crushed, not merely beaten.
그냥 고마울 따름이다 is simply grateful, not “could only be.”
SOL shifts to past tense and adds “of course” not in 아니시죠.
Makes the sidelong glance the cause of the subject change in one stroke.
은근히 재밌네 is “kind of fun,” not “surprisingly entertaining.”
Keeps the two-beat 돈 줘야지. 40억. demand.
배 째라 식 is defiant “do your worst,” not a generic refusal to pay.
SOL replaces the 뉘 집 개 이름 joke with generic “pocket change.”
“…You’re sure?” is more spoken for 확실해?
시원시원한 is straightforward, not that the answer “came readily.”
Keeps the singular 천 원 pocket-bill simile; SOL pluralizes it.
쌩 까고 is pretending it never happened, not that it “doesn’t matter.”
“That” versus “it” is indistinguishable.
SOL adds intensifying “that”; the fragment matches Taekyung’s voice.
“Treated the same as everyone else” is the natural rendering of 남들이랑 다를 것도 없습니다.
당연히 다를 게 없겠지 is “of course there isn’t,” not “of course you are.”
Merging the ponder-then-ask beat into the next sentence is better English.
Assembled with H060, the merged ask is natural and still 곰곰이 생각하다가.
“Shared the same name” is more natural than “people with the same name.”
Space after the ellipsis is standard English punctuation.
낯익음의 정체 is what the familiarity was, not why.
재작년 이맘때 is around this time two years ago; the idiom is smoother.
늦둥이 is clearer as a son born late; the hearsay is already framed as a heard story.
고개를 푹 숙이는 is hanging his head in shame.
수금해야 하는 is had to collect; 위로했다 is comforted, not a need/console swap.
Comma before “too” is indistinguishable.
냉혹한 is cruel/harsh, not merely cold.
BASE softens 야동; SOL adds an unsupported “returned it” for 나타나.
decisions.replacement: Jinho hyung, a renowned authority in the world of porn, once borrowed my USB. When he showed up again, he had a hollow-eyed expression and left me with a one-line review.

decisions.reason: 위로 is consolation, not added “words of comfort.”
아무 여자한테나 is just any woman, not every woman he saw.
Quoted “Gasp!” names the sound; “Ack!” works as spoken 헉.
SOL’s syntax is cleaner, but 손을 올렸다 is placing a hand, not grabbing.
decisions.replacement: Frightened before I had even done anything, Im Changsoo reflexively placed his hand on his sword hilt.

decisions.reason: 다가간 is closing the distance, not merely “moved.”
Splitting the fall and the neck press makes the physical sequence clearer.
연장 is the dismissive “that thing,” not a generic “weapon.”
Maps 아까 to “earlier” and 벌써 to “already forget.”
미수에 그쳤으니 is already “only an attempt”; SOL is wordier without gain.
위자료 is damages/solatium, not generic compensation.
살인미수 몰라? is “don’t you know,” not “haven’t you heard of.”
“Gaze” avoids mechanical “eyes landed” for 눈이 닿기만 해도.
협력 길드 is a partner/cooperating guild, not an allied one.
안타깝다는 듯 is pity, not “deeply disappointed.”
악질 is nasty/vicious; “rotten” drifts, and “Hm?” is only punctuation churn.
SOL’s verb is stronger, but “rotten-bastard” overreaches 악질.
decisions.replacement: Miss Song and Im Kkeokjeong delivered a lowlife-and-nasty-man combo.

decisions.reason: 마지막 한 방 is the final blow; “dealt” is tighter than “And then… delivered.”
이 제품은 is infomercial “this product”; SOL flattens that pitch.
황당함 is dumbfounded absurdity, not “disbelief.”
뭐라고 is “what did you say,” not “what was that.”
Keep 위자료 as damages; 천천히 논의해 보자 is at leisure, not calqued “slowly.”

decisions.reason: 입을 열었다 is mechanical body-part phrasing for “before speaking.”
진짜 is “really,” not “actually.”
투잡 뛰는 사람 is a clipped noun-phrase label, not “I’m a guy.”
The joke turns on 홍 sounding like flushing red; BASE only says the phrase is twisted.
